Very disappointed. Waste of my money.. I have never negatively reviewed an app before. I am VERY disappointed with this app and know that I have wasted my money. Here are all of the things wrong with it. This morning I did two of the app’s in-home walking workouts and my steps for the first workout were logged automatically by the app when I finished it. Though the workout listed a great number of steps accomplished than were actually reflected in my profile which was frustrating. But nevertheless, I proceeded to do a second workout. After I finished, the app didn’t log my steps. And then as I began to walk around the house normally while still staring at the app, feeling disappointed not to see my steps, the steps reset and went down to zero. So, according to the app, I haven’t done either workout today and I’m back to square one. THE WHOLE POINT of the app is to accurately log your steps and workouts. That’s it’s only reason to exist. If that doesn’t work, it’s pointless and A SCAM.
There are plenty of other apps and methods out there. I chose this app because I wanted a change from the step counters and apps I have used in the past not because I was unhappy with other apps like LOSEIT or FITBIT or other programs like Leslie Sansone’s Walk Away the Pounds. I just wanted to try something new and fun. BIG MISTAKE.
Here’s another problem with the app, there are only a few in-home walking videos. I can see from the reviews that this was a complaint registered over a year ago and the developers said they were busy making more content. They haven’t been busy enough, apparently. ALSO, one of the videos rips quotes and terminology straight from Leslie Sansone’s Walk Away the Pounds. I can’t believe there hasn’t been a copyright fight about this. But I will certainly be sending this review to her company.
The developers quite obviously threw up a few videos, made a very clunky and unreliable interface, and started charging people. How they have the app store score on the app store that they have is a mystery. 
As far as the videos go, the two that I’ve used this week feature women who have very little rhythm and rarely keep in time with the music. And they look like they are going through the motions. They have no energy or enthusiasm.
My whole experience with this app has been disappointing. I’ve given it a week because I thought that was fair, but I need to get on with my exercise now. The reviews and Apple policies seem to suggest that I have no hope of receiving a refund. So, I will cut my losses and cancel the app in plenty of time before they charge me again. Back to using free apps and videos that are FAR MORE useful than this app. 
The app doesn’t log steps, so what is the point of it existing except to make money for the developers.
